subject: general
question: In Δ ABC, AB and AC are produced to points D and E, respectively. If the bisectors of ∠CBD and ∠BCE meet at point O such that ∠BOC = 76°, then ∠A = ?
solution:
**Given:**

∠BOC = 76°

Concept:

If P is the meeting point of bisectors of ∠CBD and ∠BCE. Then, ∠P = 1over 2 (180º - ∠A)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8a63e6b9e65c7d188f0d3e4b2d6ac1c4c40b796269ea7402bcdfa750c3df0607.png] 

Calculation:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2880521ddc352c5d724166734008a8fd02f620d99aa2183f8be78a59dc417f0c.png] 

⇒ ∠BOC = 1over 2 (180º - ∠A)

⇒ 2 × ∠BOC = 180º - ∠A

Substituting the value of ∠BOC

⇒ 2 × 76º = 180º - ∠A

⇒ ∠A = 180º - 152º = 28º 

Hence, the value of ∠A is 28º.
